Training parameters. For all experiments, SAMformer is trained with Adam, batch size 32, a cosine annealing scheduler, and Exchange learning rate 0.001. The training/validation/test split is 70%/20%/10% on Exchange. We use a look-back window L = 512 and a sliding window with stride 1. The training loss is MSE. Training is performed during 300 epochs and we use early sto
